reader_summary.headline: Josh Koplewicz is the Managing Partner of Thayer Street Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Josh Koplewicz is the Managing Partner of Thayer Street Partners. Our conversation traces Josh's journey from his early fascination with business and real estate to building Thayer Street into an institutional platform. We discuss the lessons he learned at Goldman Sachs and his transition from scrappy dealmaker to fund manager.

key_points.text: Josh Koplewicz is the Managing Partner of Thayer Street Partners.
We cover Thayer Street's thematic sourcing, deal structuring, and portfolio construction, the evolving landscape for non-bank growth capital, challenges of scaling a boutique firm.
